overview.en:
Generate speech and manage voice agents, conversations and knowledge resources through ElevenLabs.

Prepare audio generation or voice workflows from a defined script and delivery goal. Keep voice choice, language, and pronunciation requirements explicit.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 ElevenLabs 生成语音，并管理语音智能体、会话与知识资源。

根据明确脚本与交付目标准备音频生成或语音工作流，说明声音选择、语言与发音要求。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Generate a voiceover for this script using the selected voice.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 使用选定声音为这段脚本生成配音。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available voices for this narration style.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看适合这种旁白风格的可用声音。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an audio workflow for this multilingual content brief.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这份多语言内容简报准备音频工作流。
